stable_audio_3.processing: Select the documented active event window, downmix to mono, EBU R128 normalize to -20 LUFS / -2 dBTP, add 8 ms fade-in and 30 ms fade-out, export PCM S16LE 44.1 kHz mono.

BGM-003 returned 11.122358 seconds despite the 45-second request; make a 9.622358-second cyclic unit with a 1.5-second equal-power tail/head crossfade, repeat it six times to 57.734150 seconds, and normalize to -22 LUFS / -2 dBTP.

chatterbox.processing: Trim leading and trailing silence only, normalize to -19 LUFS / -2 dBTP, resample and export PCM S16LE 44.1 kHz mono with 10 ms input and 20 ms output fades. No time stretching or text substitution.
